observations: Photo 0: A soft bonnet-style hood hair dryer, off-white/grey plastic dome with vented underside, sitting next to a coiled power cord with a UK/Nigeria-style plug and a slider control unit.
Photo 0 and 1: 'CONAIR' logo embossed on the dome; a smaller tagline under it is not legible enough to read a model number.
Photo 1: Dome attached by a purple folding arm to a round white base unit with a built-in carry/storage handle and vents; cord runs into the base.
Photo 2: Underside of the dome shows an internal air/heat vent grille and a separate base with speaker-like vents, consistent with a hood dryer unit with a blower in the base.
No shot shows the unit plugged into a wall socket, powered on, or with a lit indicator.
No close-up of the plug prongs, cord insulation, or control dial markings.
Watermarks ('SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION', 'POSTED ON JIJI') overlay the images; these are platform/seller marks, not proof of condition.

claims.claim: Versatile portable dryer suitable for hair treatments, hair drying, roller sets, deep conditioning
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the unit powered on or in use; functionality claims cannot be confirmed from static photos.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (by virtue of being listed for sale)
claims.evidence: No power-on test, no heat output, no blower sound/video provided.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat/blow air (motor, heating element, or control switch failure)
risks.proof: A video clip of the dryer plugged in, switched on, showing warm air flow and the dial/switch moving through settings

risks.risk: Cord or plug damage (fraying, bent/burnt prongs) not visible in current shots
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full cord length and plug prongs
risks.if_unproven: priced as if cord/plug condition is questionable, deducted toward worst case

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., diffuser cap, extra attachments) that may be standard with this model
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no extras

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or repairs on the dome or base not visible from these angles
risks.proof: Photos from additional angles including any seams, screws, or repair marks
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, worst-case cosmetic grade

proof_requests: Video of the dryer plugged in and running, showing heat/airflow and dial function
Close-up of the power cord and plug prongs
Photo of any included accessories or caps
Any additional angle showing the full control panel markings/model number
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type and partial brand (Conair bonnet hood dryer) from the photos, but no evidence confirms it powers on or heats, so it must be priced at worst case as non-functional until a power-on clip is provided.
